hooks.command: bash -c 'LOG="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/acd/codex-hook.log"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG")"; { read -r SID; read -r CWD; } < <(acd hook-stdin-extract session_id cwd? <&0 2>>"$LOG") || exit 0; REPO="${CWD:-$PWD}"; acd start --session-id "$SID" --harness codex --watch-pid "$PPID" --repo "$REPO" >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG"'
